repro.note: ThreadSanitizer needs ASLR off on kernels with high-entropy mmap (it prints 'unexpected memory mapping' and exits 66 without a race report); setarch is Linux only

bugs.trigger: a UART interrupt arrives between the read and the write of pending-- in app_take_event()
bugs.root_cause: pending is shared between the interrupt and the main loop without volatile or disabling interrupts around the read-modify-write
bugs.impact: the interrupt's increment is overwritten and an event is lost (E04 4.1#1)
